title: Down Home Creole spice plant: Phase 1 prototype
summary: A 2,000 sq ft blended-seasoning plant for 1,000 lb a week on one shift, launching with 5 blends and laid out for all 13. Ingredients are dosed from 9 stainless bins (12 positions) into a weigh hopper and blended in a 6 cu ft ribbon blender we build, sifted on the drum, held for QC, then packed on a bench of machines we build: servo auger filler, spindle capper, wrap labeler and a detector conveyor. 82.5 % of blend weight is dosed automatically. Stainless frames, bins, hoppers, tables and most machines are fabricated in house to save money; scales, motors, drives, valves and a used metal detector head are bought.

assembly.title: Prepare the rooms and mark the layout
assembly.text: Before any equipment: sealed epoxy floor with coved base in the two Z3 rooms, washable ceiling, 208 V 3-phase and 120 V circuits per the layout, hand sink at the vestibule. Snap the equipment outlines from drawing DH-LAY-P1 (1:50) onto the floor.
assembly.check: every outline matches DH-LAY-P1 within 25 mm [1 in]; 900 mm [36 in] aisles clear

assembly.title: Receiving and storage
assembly.text: Set the floor scale with its ramp at the receiving door and level it. Build the six NSF shelving units 6 in off the floor and 18 in from walls.
assembly.check: floor scale reads a 50 lb test weight within 0.2 lb

assembly.title: Anchor the bin ring frame
assembly.text: Stand the ring frame on its marks (ring top 2,235 mm [88.0 in], drawing ASM-P1-001), shim the foot plates level and anchor each with 1/2 in wedge anchors, 3 in embed. Seal the foot plates to the floor with food-grade silicone. Roll the 4-step platform to the bin side.
assembly.check: ring top level within 2 mm across

assembly.title: Mount the load cells and weigh hopper
assembly.text: Bolt the three weigh modules to the frame brackets, lower the hopper onto them, fit the 4 in butterfly valve on the outlet Tri-Clamp. Nothing but the silicone sleeves may touch the hopper.
assembly.check: hopper rocks freely on the cells; nothing bridges to the frame

assembly.title: Build the feeders; hang the bins, feeders and level probes
assembly.text: In the shop, build each of the 9 feeders per drawing set P1-212-000..900 (sheet 003 has the steps): drive cartridge (bearings, lip seal, pinned shaft), lantern, jaw coupling and 0.25 kW gearmotor, then hang the barrel and slide the screw in from the tail (it pulls out the tail end for cleaning). Fit the slow agitator kit on the herb and peel bins. On site, bolt each bin to its ring position with M12 bolts, the feeder to the bin outlet flange with an FDA gasket, and a silicone sleeve P1-214 from each vertical feeder spout over its hopper lid stub (2 band clamps). Fit a Soliphant in each bin's low-level port. Bins B01 to B09 in the order of dosing-plan.md (salt, garlic, paprika, onion, black pepper, coarse black pepper, cayenne, lemon peel, red pepper); positions 10 to 12 stay blanked for growth.
assembly.torque: M10 outlet flange 25 N·m; M12 bin lugs 70 N·m; M6 drive and lantern screws 8 N·m; sleeve clamps 3 N·m
assembly.check: each screw turns by hand without rubbing; every connector sits square; tag each bin

assembly.title: Build and set the ribbon blender, run the flexible screw
assembly.text: In the shop, per P1-301-GA: stand the frame, set the trough on its saddles and bolt the end plates; lower the agitator in, slide the UCF212 bearings on and bolt them to the end plates, pack the glands (4 PTFE rings each), slide the hollow-shaft gearmotor on the drive end with its torque arm. Clamp the discharge valve P1-331 to the bottom port, fit the cover with the interlock P1-332 and the bag-dump grate. Set the blender on its marks (no riser stand; trough bottom 1,400 mm [55.1 in], valve outlet 1,261 mm [49.6 in]) and anchor the feet. Run the flexible screw from the intake grate under the hopper valve (550 mm [21.7 in]) up to the 4 in inlet on the cover (1,983 mm [78.1 in]), supported at its midpoint; hand adds and premix are tipped into the intake grate.
assembly.torque: M12 end-plate and feet 70 N·m; UCF212 M16 bolts 120 N·m; gland follower M10 hand tight plus 1/4 turn
assembly.check: ribbons clear the trough by 3 to 6 mm all along; shaft turns by hand; glands do not weep; cover interlock stops the VFD; drum on its dolly rolls in between the legs

assembly.title: Drum-top sifter, magnet and drum dollies
assembly.text: Build the sifter per its own set P1-304-000..900 (assembly sheet P1-304-003): isolators into the seat ring, vibrator on its bracket (weights at 80 %), body onto the isolators, flex band and bond strap, grate magnet on the bars, 12 mesh deck on the ledge, lid on the 4 draw latches. Build the three drum dollies. Roll a lined drum in under the blender valve, set the sifter on the drum rim (seat 1,054 mm [41.5 in]) and pull the valve sock over its 4 in inlet (1,235 mm [48.6 in]).
assembly.torque: isolator nuts M8 12 N·m; vibrator M10 45 N·m + thread lock (re-check after 1 h)
assembly.check: gap body to upstand 4 ±1 all round; pads press the deck; magnet pull test card picks up; sifter sits level on the rim; ITP P1-304-900 T9-T18

assembly.title: Hammer mill, feed magnet and hopper
assembly.text: Set the mill on its stand and anchor it. Bolt the feed hopper to the mill inlet with the FDA gasket, slide the grate magnet into the hopper slot, and fit the discharge transition with a sock into a lined 5 gal pail. Connect the 150 cfm dust pickup.
assembly.torque: M8 hopper and discharge flanges 18 N·m; 3/8 in stand anchors 34 N·m
assembly.check: a 1 kg peppercorn trial grinds through the 1/8 in screen with the product under 40 °C [104 °F]; magnet pull test passes

assembly.title: Weigh bench, hood and premix tumbler
assembly.text: Place the weigh bench, bolt the backdraft hood to its back edge, set the two Mettler scales and the label printer, and set the tumbler on the bench end.
assembly.check: both scales level (bubble) and calibrated with test weights

assembly.title: Dust collection
assembly.text: Set the collector on its outside pad and run 4 in ducts to the weigh hood (300 cfm), weigh hopper vent (150 cfm), blender grate (250 cfm), drum-top sifter drum vent (200 cfm) and mill (150 cfm), with a blast gate at each.
assembly.check: measured airflow at each pickup within 10 % of its design value; total under the collector's 1,400 cfm

assembly.title: Build the pack machines
assembly.text: In the shop, per the GA sheets. Filler P1-401 rev B per its own set P1-401-000..900 (assembly sheet P1-401-003, 14 steps): cabinet and back panel, column, stage, spindle cartridge and hub, drives and guards, hopper, agitator, tooling, HMI. Capper P1-412-GA: rail and carriage on the column, gearmotor, slip clutch and chuck, gas spring. Labeler P1-404-GA: rollers in their blocks, stepper and belt, spindles, peel plate, gap sensor. Detector conveyor P1-406-GA: frame, pulleys and belt, gearmotor; mount the used detector head over the belt with nothing metal within 1.5 x the aperture height, and the reject pusher after it.
assembly.torque: filler column M12 70 N·m, head plate M10 45 N·m, servo M6 8 N·m (full list P1-401-800); M8 to frames 18 N·m; auger tube clamp hand tight
assembly.check: filler ITP P1-401-900 T9-T18 (auger 0.25 TIR in the tube);  capper clutch slips at the set torque on a torque tester; detector conveyor belt tracks centred

assembly.title: Pack bench
assembly.text: Set the filler, then line up the four stainless tables: capper and sealer, printer and labeler, the detector conveyor, checkweigh and case pack, with the turntable at the end. Set the filler stage to the container (index plunger) and fit the printed nests on the capper.
assembly.check: metal detector rejects the Fe 1.5, non-Fe 2.0 and SS 2.5 mm test pieces in the leading, middle and trailing position

assembly.title: Controls and wiring
assembly.text: Mount the WAGO panel and the nine GS21 drives, wire feeders, probes, both valve actuators, screw, blender VFD and cover interlock, sifter vibrator and mill per drawings ELE-P1-001 to 003 (every wire numbered slot-channel). E-stops and the hopper and screw guards go through the safety relay, not the PLC. A licensed electrician does the power wiring.
assembly.check: every I/O point toggles on the PLC watch list; e-stop drops all drives

assembly.title: MES computer and commissioning
assembly.text: Install the MES (software/mes) on the Dell, start it with --blender P1-301, assign B01 to B09 and load the first lots. Calibrate the hopper, tune the dosing in-flight, then run the acceptance tests below.
assembly.check: all acceptance tests pass and are signed

firmware.build: CODESYS 3.5: new WAGO PFC200 project, add DosingStation.st as a program, map the I/O
firmware.check: watch list shows Dose_Step = IDLE; HOLD alarms clear with HMI_Reset

firmware.name: Plant MES
firmware.check: http://<mes-pc>:8080 shows Ingredient bins, Blend batches and Pack runs

tests.name: Weigh hopper calibration
steps: add 20 kg, then 40 kg of test weight at each load-cell corner
tests.expect: reads within ±20 g at every corner and load

tests.name: Dose accuracy per bin
steps: dose each bin's largest planned target 5 times (dosing-plan.md)
record the hopper weight after settle
tests.expect: every dose within ±1 % (20 g minimum); in-flight learned and stable

tests.name: No-flow and bin-low holds
steps: run a feeder with its bin empty
tests.expect: NO FLOW alarm within 8 s; BIN LOW stops the step

tests.name: Blend uniformity
steps: pull 10 samples top, middle and bottom

tests.name: Metal detector (CCP-1)
steps: pass each test piece in leading, middle and trailing position, 3 times
tests.expect: every pass rejected into the locked bin

tests.name: Net contents (NIST HB 133)
steps: fill 30 units of each launch size
tests.expect: average ≥ declared; no unit short by more than the MAV

tests.name: Traceability drill
tests.expect: every batch and pallet found in under 2 hours

tests.name: Food-safety design checks
tests.expect: zoning, sanitary, dust airflow, shared equipment all PASS
